controls.name: Logical and Physical Access Controls
controls.description: Restrict logical and physical access to systems and data.
controls.action_template: Review access controls for exposed services and SSL configuration.

controls.name: Logical Access Controls
controls.description: Protect against unauthorized access to applications and data.
controls.action_template: Sanitize user inputs and implement WAF rules to block XSS/injection attacks.

controls.name: Security for Remote Computing
controls.description: Security controls must extend to remote access and mobile devices.
controls.action_template: Close unnecessary ports. Restrict admin and database ports to VPN/firewall.

controls.name: Vulnerability Management
controls.description: Identify and remediate security vulnerabilities on a timely basis.
controls.action_template: Apply patches for identified CVEs. Prioritize critical/high severity vulnerabilities.

controls.name: Change Management
controls.description: Manage changes to infrastructure, applications, and configurations.
controls.action_template: Audit DNS records and subdomain configurations for unauthorized shadow resources.

controls.name: Injection
controls.description: Prevent injection attacks including SQL, LDAP, OS command injection.
controls.action_template: Use parameterized queries. Sanitize and validate all user-supplied input before processing.

controls.name: Data Integrity
controls.description: Ensure the integrity of data in transit and at rest.
controls.action_template: Renew expired SSL certificates. Enforce TLS 1.2+. Enable HSTS and fix certificate chain issues.

controls.name: Logging and Monitoring
controls.description: Detect, log, and respond to security events and anomalies.
controls.action_template: Enable comprehensive security logging. Ensure scans cover all critical assets and subdomains.

controls.name: Access Control
controls.description: Implement technical policies and procedures that allow only authorized persons access to EPHI.
controls.action_template: Close public access to databases/remote tooling and enforce TLS on entry points.

controls.name: Integrity Controls
controls.description: Implement policies to protect EPHI from improper alteration or destruction.
controls.action_template: Prevent tampering through input sanitation and transmission integrity.

controls.name: Protection from Malicious Software
controls.description: Procedures for guarding against, detecting, and reporting malicious software.
controls.action_template: Ensure systems are patched against known CVEs to prevent malware entry.

controls.name: Network Security Controls
controls.description: Install and maintain network security controls (firewalls) to protect cardholder data.
controls.action_template: Remove open administrative or database ports from direct internet access.

controls.name: Secure Systems and Software
controls.description: Develop and maintain secure systems and software.
controls.action_template: Fix vulnerabilities like XSS and Injection defects in application layer.

controls.name: Regular Testing
controls.description: Regularly test security systems and networks.
controls.action_template: Address newly detected critical and high CVEs identified via vulnerability scanning.

controls.name: Network Security Management
controls.description: Networks shall be managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.
controls.action_template: Improve perimeter defenses by fixing SSL configuration and exposed logical ports.

controls.name: Technical Vulnerability Management
controls.description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems being used shall be obtained.

controls.name: Security in Application Systems
controls.description: Rules for the development of software and systems shall be established.
controls.action_template: Eliminate web application vulnerabilities such as XSS during development operations.
